digest.component_or_area: overlap judge / plan review advisory classifier
propositions: Batched overlap judge constructs RunRequest without operation-local output, retry, transport, or timeout bounds, inheriting generic 16,000-token / 600-second policy
Malformed candidate_id responses trigger three sequential native structured generations before safe abstention, causing 216–311 second latency and 21,000–47,000 character payloads
Token-only or schema-only constraints are insufficient; output retries must be explicitly capped to prevent multiple long generations of malformed content
RunRequest must expose lowering-only per-operation seams for structured_retry_max_attempts, transport_attempt_max, and timeout_s before model construction

Overlap judge calls must declare explicit advisory budgets: 1,024 output tokens, one structured attempt, one transport attempt, 60-second timeout to degrade timeout/truncation/malformed output to exact all-candidate abstention
Repair preserves valid verdict demultiplexing, existing caller defaults, and documented advisory-only graceful-skip intent from story 9022 and ADR 0086
